title: GREENHOUSE
height: walls 2.8 m under a glass dome rising 3.4 m
notes: Size, dais, ledges from the game (module_floors.gd 16 x 18, corners 1.2; stepped_floor.gd dais north 0.9 m high 2 m deep, ledges east/west/south 0.42 m high 1 m deep, cut by a 2.4 m aisle at each door).
Home plot grows from 5 x 5 beds (3 m, shaded) to 20 x 20 (12 m) from cell (2, 2) (home_plot.gd).
Robot station: 3 bays with charging (robot_hub.gd); mealworm bin 3 x 1 (farm_kinds.gd); water tank and dosing unit on the dais (greenhouse_rig.gd).

The 0.9 m dais along the north wall (the game's stepped floor) is dropped: the concept K09 shows the north strip on the deck's own level, the water tank standing on the deck (scene-record stage, 2026-10-12). The home plot is the concept's: one 12 x 12 m bed of soil in a low curb, which the scene-record stage lays as plain plates; its crops are the crops track's.

concept.read: the concept K09 read element by element (scene-record stage, 2026-10-12), each element mapped to the inventory's rows (data/inventory/greenhouse.json), a plan door or item, or dropped with its reason

E.why: the open hatch (the room layout's open list) onto the base's west walkway tube, seated on the Moon ground, which runs east to the hub

S.why: a walkway tube runs south to the garage's north hatch (the garage's plan joins it here); its leaf (inventory hatch_leaf) swings open

N.why: a walkway tube runs north to the hangar's south hatch (the hangar's plan joins it here); its leaf (inventory hatch_leaf) swings open

W.why: no walkway tube joined there; its hatch leaf stays shut (inventory hatch_leaf)
